imports_abandon_confirm_body: The file you uploaded and everything prepared from it will be deleted. Nothing has been imported yet.
imports_assistance_body: Let someone on the support team open it and convert it for you. You will review what they send back before anything is imported.
imports_assistance_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_assistance_waiting: We have your file and will convert it. You will be told when it is ready to review.
imports_empty_body: Start from the Templates, Contacts or Team page, or upload an export here if you are not sure what it is.
imports_invites_sent: {sent} invitations sent, {failed} could not be delivered.
imports_mapping_intro: The first rows of your file are shown so you can tell the columns apart.
imports_mapping_needs_email: Choose which column holds the email address.
imports_mapping_needs_name: Choose which column holds the name.
imports_mapping_ratings_choices_help: Every item becomes a list of these answers to pick from.
imports_mapping_ratings_hint: Statutory codes such as I / NI / NP / D are the second kind.
imports_mapping_ratings_none_help: Every item becomes a box to type into.
imports_mapping_ratings_severity: They say how serious a problem is
imports_mapping_ratings_severity_help: Every item keeps them, and an inspector picks one as he works.
imports_mapping_template_needs_name: Give the imported template a name.
imports_page_subtitle: Bring templates, contacts and team members over from another product.
imports_pdf_blank_body: Send a template with no inspection in it. A finished report carries a client, an address and a signature, and this upload will refuse it.
imports_pdf_blank_how: The step is the same in every product: open the template in your current software, then print or export it to PDF before entering any inspection.
imports_pdf_scan_clean_headline: No personal information was detected by our checks.
imports_pdf_scan_clean_limit: This check is not a guarantee that the file contains no personal information. You are responsible for removing personal information before upload.
imports_pdf_scan_found_headline: This file has not been accepted.
imports_pdf_scan_found_intro: Something on these pages reads as personal information. Remove it and upload the file again.
imports_pdf_scan_withheld: The page and the kind are all that is reported. The text that matched is not shown here and is not written to any log.
imports_pdf_statement: I am uploading a template with no inspection in it, and I have removed any personal information from it.
imports_pdf_upload_hint: A PDF, printed from a template you have not filled in.
imports_preview_aftercare_comments: Imported comments land under Information unless the file said which tab they belong to.
imports_preview_aftercare_order: Sections keep the order they had in the file. Reorder them in the editor.
imports_preview_aftercare_ratings: Open one item in the editor and check its ratings read the way you expect.
imports_preview_all_plain: All of this template's items came through as plain text boxes, so there is nothing to rate on any of them.
imports_preview_dropped_lead: Entries the conversion could not bring over:
imports_preview_empty_sections: Sections that came through with nothing in them: {names}
imports_preview_intro: The counts on the last step add up whatever the conversion did. This is where you can see whether it worked.
imports_preview_most_plain: Most of this template's items came through as plain text boxes, so there is nothing to rate on them.
imports_preview_none: No problems found in the structure.
imports_preview_some_plain: {count} items came through as plain text boxes while the rest kept something to pick from.
imports_preview_warnings_lead: What the conversion had to decide for you:
imports_repair_fix_first: Entries that still cannot be imported: {count}.
imports_repair_not_editable: This entry cannot be corrected here. Discard the import and fix the file.
imports_revert_confirm_body: Everything this import created or replaced will be taken back. Anything that cannot be taken back will be listed.
imports_run_not_found: This import could not be found. It may have been discarded.
imports_sheet_help: This workbook has more than one sheet. Pick the one that holds the list — the others are ignored.
imports_sheet_unreadable_assisted: This workbook could not be read here. It will be uploaded as it is, and someone will convert it.
imports_sheet_unreadable_standalone: This workbook could not be read here. Save the sheet you want as CSV and choose that file instead.
imports_source_file_csv_generic: Any .csv or .xlsx whose first row names the columns.
imports_source_file_home_inspector_pro: The .tpz or .tpzx in its Data folder.
imports_source_file_spectora: The .xls or .xlsx its Templates screen exports.
imports_source_pick_legend: Which product is this export from?
imports_source_read_by_nobody: Nothing here reads this format yet, and this deployment has no one to hand it to. Export a spreadsheet from it instead, or build the template here.
imports_source_read_by_pdf: You can also print a blank template to PDF and upload that instead — read here, now.
imports_source_read_by_person: Nothing here reads this format yet, so someone on the support team converts it by hand: confirmed within 2 working days, back with you within 10.
imports_source_read_here: Read as soon as you upload it — seconds, not minutes. Stay on this page while it reads.
imports_source_replace_note: To bring in a different file, start a new import from the Imports page. Replacing the file here would throw away every correction made since it was read.
imports_start_needs_source: Say which product this export came from.
imports_start_unknown: I have an export and I am not sure what it is
imports_start_unknown_intent: That is not something this page can import.
imports_undo_expired: The entries this undo reads have been cleared, so it is no longer available.
imports_unsupported_body: This import accepts a Spectora template export (JSON), or a spreadsheet saved as CSV or Excel.
imports_unsupported_title: Nothing here can read this file
imports_upload_authorize: Keep this file so I can change the column mapping and come back to this page later.
imports_upload_authorize_help: We store it with your inspection files. It is deleted with this import.
imports_upload_hint: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or a template export (.json)
imports_upload_needs_authorize: Agree to us keeping the file, so this import can be picked up again later.
imports_upload_needs_sheet: Choose which sheet holds the list.
imports_upload_needs_staff_authorize: Agree to someone on the support team opening the file, because nothing here can read it.
imports_upload_needs_statement: Say what you did to the file before you can choose it.
imports_upload_staff_authorize: If nothing here can read it, let someone on the support team open it and convert it.
imports_upload_staff_authorize_help: This file may contain your clients' names, email addresses and phone numbers.
offline_import_attention_intro: These queued changes were not applied. The results and photos of their inspections were still imported, and these changes will not be sent again.
offline_import_choose_empty_body: When a device cannot sync, the app can export what it holds as a .zip file. Choose that file here to import it. Nothing is uploaded until you confirm.
offline_import_choose_hint: A .zip file exported from the app, up to {size}.
offline_import_confirm_body: Inspections: {inspections}, queued changes: {changes}, photos: {photos}. All of it will be added to this company. Importing the same package again is safe: anything already imported is skipped.
offline_import_confirm_privacy: This file contains client personal information and is not encrypted. Keeping it safe, and deleting it afterwards, is your company's responsibility.
offline_import_download_failed: The download could not be prepared in this browser. Your file has not been changed; try again.
offline_import_err_empty: That file is empty. Choose the package the app exported.
offline_import_err_not_zip: That file is not a .zip package. Choose the .zip file the app exported.
offline_import_err_too_large: That file is {actual}, which is over the {max} limit, so it was not sent. Export the inspections again in smaller groups from the app.
offline_import_err_unreadable: This is not a valid offline package, so nothing was sent. Choose the file exactly as the app exported it.
offline_import_held_answer_none: No confirmed answer from the server
offline_import_held_intro: These inspections were not imported. Nothing was lost: download a part to keep it, fix the cause, and import it again.
offline_import_match_bad: This package belongs to a different company, so it cannot be imported here. Sign in to the company it was exported from, or ask for a new export.
offline_import_match_ok: This package was exported for this company.
offline_import_next_apply_failed: Download this part and import it again later. If it keeps failing, give the downloaded part and the answer shown to whoever runs this deployment.
offline_import_next_deleted: There is nothing to import for it. Keep the downloaded part only if you still need its data.
offline_import_next_different_report: Download this part and have the person who exported it check which report is current before importing again.
offline_import_next_expired: Your file has not been changed. Export the data again from the device that holds it.
offline_import_next_forbidden: Ask an owner or manager who can open it to import this part.
offline_import_next_future: Check the date and time on the device that exported it, then export again. Your file has not been changed.
offline_import_next_gave_up: Nothing was lost. Import the same file again later: importing is safe to repeat, and what was already imported is skipped.
offline_import_next_not_found: Check that it was not removed, then keep the downloaded part until you know what to do with it.
offline_import_next_package_rejected: Your file has not been changed. Export it again from the app, or download this part and try again.
offline_import_next_refused: Download this part, reload this page to get the latest version, and import it again.
offline_import_next_session: Sign in again and import again; your file has not been changed. If it happens again, check that the package was exported from this company.
offline_import_next_too_large: Download this part to keep it, and export the inspection again from the app with fewer photos.
offline_import_page_subtitle: Bring in work a team member captured offline when their device could not sync. Their inspections, queued changes and photos are added to this company, and anything already imported is skipped.
offline_import_preview_note: Nothing has been uploaded yet. This summary was read in your browser.
offline_import_privacy_note: A package holds client personal information and is not encrypted. Keep it safe, and delete it once it has been imported.
offline_import_progress_counts: {imported} inspections imported so far, {held} left behind
offline_import_progress_note: Parts are sent one at a time. Keep this page open until it finishes. If it is interrupted, import the same file again: nothing is duplicated.
offline_import_result_all_imported: Everything in this package was imported.
offline_import_result_all_skipped: Everything in this package had already been imported, so nothing changed.
offline_import_result_none_imported: Nothing in this package could be imported. Your file has not been changed: read why below, then import it again.
offline_import_run_failed: The import could not start. Nothing was sent. Check that the file is the package the app exported, then try again.
offline_import_what_apply_failed: The server could not apply this inspection's data or one of its changes.
offline_import_what_deleted: This inspection was deleted after the package was exported.
offline_import_what_different_report: The report in the package is not the report this inspection has now.
offline_import_what_expired: This package is more than {days} days old and can no longer be imported.
offline_import_what_forbidden: Your account is not allowed to change this inspection.
offline_import_what_future_one: This package is dated more than 1 day ahead of the server's clock, so it was refused.
offline_import_what_future_other: This package is dated more than {days} days ahead of the server's clock, so it was refused.
offline_import_what_gave_up: The server did not confirm this part in time.
offline_import_what_local: Something failed in this browser before the server could confirm this part.
offline_import_what_not_found: This inspection does not exist in this company.
offline_import_what_package_rejected: The server refused the package as a whole, so no inspection in it was imported.
offline_import_what_refused: The server refused this inspection for a reason this version does not recognize.
offline_import_what_session: Your session may have expired or you may not have permission to import.
offline_import_what_too_large: This inspection alone is larger than the server accepts in one request.
